crossRefs.note: When he had finished speaking, he threw the jawbone out of his hand; and that place was called Ramath Lehi.
crossRefs.keyword: Ramath-lehi. that is, the lifting up of the jaw-bone, or,the casting away of the jaw-bone

people.name: Ramath-lehi
people.line: The place where Samson killed a thousand Philistines

translations.web: When he had finished speaking, he threw the jawbone out of his hand; and that place was called Ramath Lehi.
translations.bsb: And when Samson had finished speaking, he cast the jawbone from his hand; and he named that place Ramath-lehi.
translations.kjv: And it came to pass, when he had made an end of speaking, that he cast away the jawbone out of his hand, and called that place Ramathlehi.
translations.asv: And it came to pass, when he had made an end of speaking, that he cast away the jawbone out of his hand; and that place was called Ramath-lehi.
